subject: computer-science
title: Logic Gates: Boolean in Code
welcome_lead: Boolean logic isn't only circuits — it lives inside every IF you write.
meta_desc: KS3 boolean: AND/OR/NOT in code, conditions and combined tests.
final_note: Master booleans and you master selection in any language.

concepts.def: A value that is True or False.
An expression that gives a boolean.
At least one side must be true.
Flips true to false and back.
Combination of values that gives a result.

walkthroughs.body_html: if age > 12 and age < 20: combines two tests with and. Both must be true.
if day == 'sat' or day == 'sun': uses or. if not raining: uses not to flip the meaning.
Code conditions follow exactly the same truth tables as gates. Drawing one out is a great way to debug tricky ifs.
